title: CodeCompass Universal Reverse Engineering & Analysis Adapter Ecosystem
goal: Extend Ananta CodeCompass with reusable tool adapters for source, binary, decompilation, static/dynamic analysis, and agentic investigation while preserving existing trust and evidence architecture.
purpose: Research and implementation track; CodeCompass remains the canonical source/graph intelligence layer, adapters provide evidence, Ananta orchestrates.

source_review.kind: Repository docs and schemas inspected; implementation not yet audited

architecture_principles: Reuse Hub-owned snapshot/revision/idempotency and authoritative source catalog.
Do not vendor floating upstream tools; pin versions and verify licenses.
No implicit trusted evidence from decompiled or tool-generated output.
Plugins declare capabilities; unavailable tooling must degrade explicitly.
Retain contradictions and exact/heuristic mapping distinctions.
Sandbox untrusted binary processing; authorization for dynamic instrumentation.
